dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 毎日運動することにした。
dialogue.translation: I decided to exercise every day.
dialogue.translation_en: I decided to exercise every day.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya memutuskan untuk berolahraga setiap hari.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 雨が降りそうです。
dialogue.translation: It looks like it will rain.
dialogue.translation_en: It looks like it will rain.
dialogue.translation_id: Sepertinya akan turun hujan.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 明日、荷物を持っていきます。
dialogue.translation: I will take the luggage with me tomorrow.
dialogue.translation_en: I will take the luggage with me tomorrow.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya akan membawa barang bawaan saya besok.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 雨が降ってきた。
dialogue.translation: It started to rain.
dialogue.translation_en: It started to rain.
dialogue.translation_id: Hujan mulai turun.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 新しいレストランで食べてみる。
dialogue.translation: I will try eating at the new restaurant.
dialogue.translation_en: I will try eating at the new restaurant.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya akan mencoba makan di restoran baru.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: この本は高いに違いない。
dialogue.translation: This book must be expensive.
dialogue.translation_en: This book must be expensive.
dialogue.translation_id: Buku ini pasti mahal.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 朝ご飯を食べずに出かけた。
dialogue.translation: I went out without eating breakfast.
dialogue.translation_en: I went out without eating breakfast.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya keluar tanpa sarapan.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 今度の週末は何もするつもりはない。
dialogue.translation: I don't plan to do anything this weekend.
dialogue.translation_en: I don't plan to do anything this weekend.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya tidak berencana melakukan apa pun akhir pekan ini.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 明日の朝のために水を出しておく。
dialogue.translation: I will put out water for tomorrow morning.
dialogue.translation_en: I will put out water for tomorrow morning.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya akan mengeluarkan air untuk besok pagi.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 友達が傘を貸してくれた。
dialogue.translation: My friend lent me an umbrella.
dialogue.translation_en: My friend lent me an umbrella.
dialogue.translation_id: Temanku meminjamiku payung.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 田中さんに日本語を教えてもらう。
dialogue.translation: I receive Japanese lessons from Tanaka.
dialogue.translation_en: I receive Japanese lessons from Tanaka.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya menerima pelajaran bahasa Jepang dari Tanaka.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: この料理はおいしいに決まっている。
dialogue.translation: This dish is definitely delicious.
dialogue.translation_en: This dish is definitely delicious.
dialogue.translation_id: Hidangan ini pasti enak.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 明日から禁煙することにします。
dialogue.translation: I will decide to quit smoking from tomorrow.
dialogue.translation_en: I will decide to quit smoking from tomorrow.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya akan memutuskan untuk berhenti merokok mulai besok.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 来年、日本に留学するつもりだ。
dialogue.translation: I intend to study abroad in Japan next year.
dialogue.translation_en: I intend to study abroad in Japan next year.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya berniat untuk belajar di luar negeri di Jepang tahun depan.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: これからも頑張っていく。
dialogue.translation: I will keep doing my best from now on.
dialogue.translation_en: I will keep doing my best from now on.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya akan terus melakukan yang terbaik mulai sekarang.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 先生が漢字を教えてくれた。
dialogue.translation: The teacher taught me kanji.
dialogue.translation_en: The teacher taught me kanji.
dialogue.translation_id: Guru mengajari saya kanji.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: この靴を履いてみてもいいですか。
dialogue.translation: May I try on these shoes?
dialogue.translation_en: May I try on these shoes?
dialogue.translation_id: Bolehkah saya mencoba sepatu ini?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: あの人が合格するに決まっている。
dialogue.translation: That person will definitely pass.
dialogue.translation_en: That person will definitely pass.
dialogue.translation_id: Orang itu pasti lolos.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 何も言わずに帰った。
dialogue.translation: I went home without saying anything.
dialogue.translation_en: I went home without saying anything.
dialogue.translation_id: Aku pulang ke rumah tanpa berkata apa-apa.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 友達に本を貸してあげた。
dialogue.translation: I lent a book to my friend.
dialogue.translation_en: I lent a book to my friend.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya meminjamkan sebuah buku kepada teman saya.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: ドアを開けておいてください。
dialogue.translation: Please leave the door open.
dialogue.translation_en: Please leave the door open.
dialogue.translation_id: Silakan biarkan pintunya terbuka.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 財布を落としてしまった。
dialogue.translation: I dropped my wallet (by accident).
dialogue.translation_en: I dropped my wallet (by accident).
dialogue.translation_id: Saya menjatuhkan dompet saya (secara tidak sengaja).

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 父に車を貸してもらった。
dialogue.translation: My father lent me his car.
dialogue.translation_en: My father lent me his car.
dialogue.translation_id: Ayah saya meminjamkan mobilnya kepada saya.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 彼女は猫みたいだ。
dialogue.translation: She is like a cat.
dialogue.translation_en: She is like a cat.
dialogue.translation_id: Dia seperti kucing.
